page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words; running head at top centre-left, page number at top right.

main_text.p: קרר Chal. Frigescere. Hinc in Ithpahel אִתְקְרַר, Refrigerare,reficere se, Exod.2.5.in Targ.Jon.& 7.15. in Hierosf.
קְרִיר קָרִיר Ch. Frigidum.Plur.קְרִירִין. Syr. ܩܪܝܪܐ Poculum frigidarum,sc. aquarum,Matt.10.42.
קרש Ch. Coagulare, condensare, congelare, Iobi 10.10.& 38.30. Ithpahel אִתְקְרַשׁ Coagulari, condensari,Num.25.8.in Jon.
ܩܦܠ, ܩܦܠ Syriac. Gelu, Frigus, Johan. 18.18. Act. 28.2.

קשא קשֵׁה Chald. & Syriac. Durum, Grave, Difficile esse. Aphel אַקְשִׁי Indurare, Obdurare, Durum praebere se. Pahel קַשִּׁי Idem. Ex Ithpahel Particip. Chald. דְּמִתְקַשִּׁי לְהוֹן Quae difficilis fuit ipsis, Levitic.24.12. in Jonath. Plural. Syriac. ܐܬܩܫܘ Indurabantur, Actor.19.9. Futurum ܠܐ ܢܬܩܫ Neque induretur, ad Hebr.3.13.
קְשָׁיָא, קַשִּׁי, קַשִּׁין. Chald. Durus, Difficilis. Plural. Syriac. ܩܫܝܐ, ܩܫܝܢ, Actorum 7.51. emph.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are reproduced approximately from the scan; Syriac and Hebrew vowel points and diacritics are uncertain in several places. Faint show-through text from the reverse side of the page was omitted. The bottom-right Syriac word and the faint marks near the foot are doubtful.
